plugins.name: sql-quality-check
plugins.description: Analyze SQL files for performance issues like full table scans, ineffective joins, and inefficient queries. CI-friendly reporting.

plugins.name: sql-quality-fix
plugins.description: Automatically fix SQL performance issues with step-by-step measurement. Rewrites SQL, creates indexes, measures impact, rolls back ineffective changes.

plugins.name: sql-params-generate
plugins.description: Generate parameter bindings for SQL files by analyzing database schema and extracting placeholders.
